description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Winding up Order of ETI Finance Ltd.
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the court-ordered winding up of a financial company (ETI Finance Limited) under the supervision of the Commercial High Court. It involves the appointment of a liquidator and procedures for handling the company's assets and costs. This falls under commercial matters, specifically corporate dissolution and bankruptcy proceedings, which aligns with Type 6 (Commercial Gazettes) for business and commercial regulatory actions.
